name: Bolalar uchun rezina soska Chicco 0+ (2 dona)
notes: hand-written seed case, not from a customer file (pacifier-absent-from-catalog, hard): No pacifier code exists in the classifier at all — searching soska/emizik returns herbal tea and food supplements. Official guidance is to fall back to 'other articles of plastics not elsewhere specified'. Tests whether the pipeline degrades to a defensible general code instead of forcing a spurious specific match.

name: Yog'och taxta chinor 50mm
notes: hand-written seed case, not from a customer file (timber-strict-unit, medium): Processed timber with a strictly bound unit of kub. metr. Tests that a matching strict unit is surfaced and does not trigger UNIT_CONFLICT.

name: Shakar-rafinad qadoqlangan 1 kg
notes: hand-written seed case, not from a customer file (sugar-single-mandatory-unit, easy): Packaged refined sugar, strictly bound to 'dona'. A catalogue that writes kg here should raise UNIT_CONFLICT — this case uses the correct unit so it must not.

name: Kartoshka
notes: hand-written seed case, not from a customer file (vegetable-potato, easy): A bare one-word vegetable name with a base code. Should be an easy top-1; if this fails, retrieval is broken.

name: Ginekolog qabuli / konsultatsiya
notes: hand-written seed case, not from a customer file (medical-service, hard): Gate 0 established that no source exposes deprecation, so this tests that the current service code is found. NOTE: the original label here was 'Akusher-ginekolog maslahati'; 'Ginekolog maslahati' is the closer reading of the query and was promoted after review. Service codes are bound to the unit 'xizmat'.

name: PANADOL 500mg tabletka N12
notes: hand-written seed case, not from a customer file (pharma-branded-inn, hard): Pharmaceuticals are a separately refined group: names carry the INN plus ATC code plus manufacturer. Tests that a brand name reaches the right identifying code, and that the digital-marking rule permits an identifying code here (pharma is marked).

name: Sement M400 50 kg qop
notes: hand-written seed case, not from a customer file (cement-no-base-code, hard): The Portlandsement subposition 02523002001 has NO base code, so the 'prefer base codes' rule cannot be satisfied there. The defensible answer is the general 'other types of cement'. Tests behaviour when the safe fallback does not exist.

name: Gilam sintetik 200x300 sm
notes: hand-written seed case, not from a customer file (carpet-synthetic, medium): Carpets are a separately refined group bound to kv. metr. The name carries dimensions that must be parsed as an attribute, not matched as text. Several codes in the GILAMLAR group are defensible for 'sintetik gilam', so they are all acceptable.

name: G'isht keramik M150
notes: hand-written seed case, not from a customer file (construction-brick-ambiguous, hard): Construction materials are the documented ambiguity case: eight distinct brick codes exist across four groups (06815, 06901, 06902, 06904) with near-identical names. Tests hierarchy-based disambiguation.

name: Palov 1 porsiya
notes: hand-written seed case, not from a customer file (palov-prepared-dish, hard): Prepared dishes deliberately have no detailed MXIK: searching 'palov' returns only seasonings *for* palov. The answer is the catering 'main dishes, meat' code. Note this general code is itself NOT a base code, so the base-code preference must not override it.

name: Amstel alkogolsiz pivo 0,33 L alyuminiy banka
notes: hand-written seed case, not from a customer file (marked-good-identifying, medium): A digitally marked good (label=1) where the identifying code carrying brand and packaging is required, not the base code. Also exercises barcode-exact retrieval at confidence 1.0.

name: Guruch bo'tqasi
notes: hand-written seed case, not from a customer file (barcoded-good-base-sufficient, medium): An ordinary unmarked good written generically, where the base code ending 000000 is sufficient and correct. Tests that the pipeline does not over-specify to a branded identifying code when the name names no brand.
